Myeloablative Allogeneic: Many leukemias, lymphomas, myelodysplastic syndromes, myeloproliferative neoplasms, multiple myeloma, marrow failure states (e.g., aplastic anemia), select inherited immunodeficiencies, metabolic disorders, and hemoglobinopathies
Myeloablative Autologous: Multiple myeloma, lymphomas, germ cell tumors, neuroblastoma

Myeloablative Allogeneic: Hepatic SOS, shock syndromes, nephrotoxic drugs, CNIs, acute TMA
Myeloablative Autologous: Shock syndromes, nephrotoxic drugs, occasionally hepatic SOS
Nonmyeloablative Allogeneic: Shock syndromes, nephrotoxic drugs, CNIs, acute TMA

Myeloablative Allogeneic: Irreversible AKI, kidney TMA, CNIs, GVHD
Myeloablative Autologous: Irreversible AKI, pretransplant CKD (e.g., kidney involvement by amyloidosis or multiple myeloma)
Nonmyeloablative Allogeneic: Pretransplant mild CKD, irreversible AKI, CNIs, GVHD
